Container.Name: personal-paper
Container.Overview:
Personal Paper: a one-reader morning newspaper, called whatever its reader types on the Look tab. It gathers the day's calendar, tasks, weather and Substack posts, renders a black-and-white US Letter broadsheet as a PDF, and prints it over IPP and/or emails it, on a schedule set from its own web page.
Host networking is the default because mDNS printer discovery only works when the container shares the host's broadcast domain. On bridge networking discovery finds nothing and the printer is entered as an IP on the Output tab.
WEB_PASSWORD is optional: leave it empty and the page has no login (anyone on your network can open it); set it to require a password. Everything else the reader changes (look, sources, routes, schedule) lives in the web page, not here.

Config.Name: Web page
Config.Description: The settings, preview and status page, and POST /tasks for the iPhone Shortcut. On host networking this port must be free on the box.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: settings.json, state.json, tasks.json, logs/, out/ and the PDF archive. Nothing secret is kept here.

Config.Name: Unraid notify script
Config.Description: Optional. Mount this to let a failed run raise an Unraid notification (Output tab, Notify on failure = unraid).

Config.Name: WEB_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Optional. Password for the web page (any username). Leave empty for no login; then anyone on your network can open the page.

Config.Name: TASKS_TOKEN
Config.Description: Bearer token the iPhone Shortcut sends to POST /tasks. Leave empty to disable the task endpoint.

Config.Name: SMTP_HOST
Config.Description: Outgoing mail server for the email route and failure notifications.

Config.Name: SMTP_USER
Config.Description: The account the paper is sent from; it is also the From address.

Config.Name: SMTP_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for SMTP_USER. A Gmail app password works.

Config.Name: NYT_S
Config.Description: NYT-S cookie from nytimes.com (Developer tools → Application → Cookies). Needs a Games subscription. Valid about a year. Only needed for the crossword; leave empty and the paper prints without one.

Config.Name: IMAP_HOST
Config.Description: Only needed if a paid Substack has to be read from email instead of RSS.

Config.Name: IMAP_USER
Config.Description: Mailbox the Substack emails land in. Only for paid publications.

Config.Name: IMAP_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for IMAP_USER. A Gmail app password works.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for the schedule, the calendar window and the weather.

Config.Name: IMAP_MAILBOX
Config.Description: Mailbox or Gmail label the Substack emails land in. Default INBOX.

Config.Name: DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Where settings, state, logs and the archive live inside the container. Change this only if the Data path above is mapped somewhere else.

Config.Name: CHROMIUM_PATH
Config.Description: Advanced. Path to a Chromium binary for the renderer. The image already ships Playwright's Chromium; leave empty.
